text:
Aaron (AE): AcmeCorp asks for a 2-week POC. Requirements: Dedicated or peered compute, audit logs exported to their S3 with 365d retention, and short-lived API keys for devs. Also need SOC2 artifacts. Can we do this and what do we need from them?

Maya (SE): Yes. Two patterns: 1) Hosted compute + log-only export (cheaper) or 2) Dedicated pool with VPC peering (stronger isolation). Either can stream audit events to customer bucket. We default to redacting prompt/response bodies and emitting hashes and metadata.

Lee (Client-Sec): must not include raw prompt text in bucket by default. Need client IP and request_id in metadata. Also want proof of delivery (object checksum + timestamp).

Ethan (Security): For SOC2 evidence we'll supply: masked audit samples, TLS+SSE-KMS proof, RBAC roles list, and short data flow diagram. We need customer to confirm data classification and if any PII will be sent.

Devon (Infra): What we need from Acme:
- S3 bucket ARN + region
- KMS key ARN if they want CMK
- Customer AWS account or principal for cross-account role
- Allowed prefix (e.g., acme/poc-audit/)
- CIDR block for peering if Dedicated
Sample bucket policy we can provide once ticket is open.

Maya (SE): Ephemeral keys: we support token-exchange with TTL. Example (pseudo):
```bash
# exchange svc token for ephemeral key
curl -X POST https://token.redwood/v1/exchange -H 'Authorization: Bearer <svc>' -d '{"scope":"invoke","ttl":3600}'
```
Issued keys are scoped and expire; issuance is logged.

Aaron (AE): Pricing question: 2-week Dedicated small pool estimate?

Maya (SE): rough estimate: daily rate for small slice + storage/egress. I'll follow up with a quote and include audit export egress. Option: run compute hosted to cut compute cost ~30%.

opsbot: checklist: 1) NDA 2) bucket ARN + KMS 3) CIDR 4) list of devs for scoped tokens 5) retention (365d) 6) PII classification

Aaron (AE): I'll request NDA and ask Acme for bucket/KMS/CIDR today. Maya/Devon please open infra ticket and tag Ethan for SOC2 artifacts.

Lee (Client-Sec): ack, will send PII list and confirm they want client_ip included. Thanks. :thumbsup:
